info.name: GetKempt API
info.description:
Generated from src/main/resources/static/openapi.yaml by tools/generate-postman.py, limited to routes implemented by the backend.

1. Select the *GetKempt Local* environment.
2. Run **Auth → Signup** (or **Login**); the test script stores `accessToken`.
3. Every other request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` automatically.
Create requests store the new resource id (e.g. `clientId`) for the follow-up calls.

item.name: Create a new shop owner / barber account.

request.description:
Creates a new `User` AND a tenant `StoreProfile` in one transaction.
Sends an email verification link. Returns the auth pair so the client
can start the onboarding flow immediately without re-logging in.

Idempotent on `email` — second call with same email returns 409.

item.name: Exchange email + password for a token pair.

request.description: Exchange email + password for a token pair.

Adds the JWT's `jti` to the revocation set. Subsequent requests with
the same token are 401-ed. Idempotent.

item.name: Exchange a refresh token for a fresh access + refresh pair.

request.description:
Refresh tokens rotate — the old refresh token is single-use. Re-using
a refresh token is treated as a compromise and invalidates the chain.

Always returns 204 — the API never reveals whether the email exists,
to prevent account enumeration.

request.description:
The general-purpose list endpoint. For calendar views, prefer
`/bookings/calendar` which is optimised for date-range fetches and
includes staff colour metadata.

The endpoint is transactional:
  1. Validates the slot against weekly schedule, overrides, and existing bookings.
  2. Creates a `Client` inline if `client` is provided.
  3. Snapshots service name/price/duration onto the booking row.
  4. Computes applicable surcharges from settings.
  5. If the shop's `paymentMode` requires a deposit, creates a
     `PaymentIntent` and returns it in the response so the frontend
     can confirm with Stripe.js.
  6. Schedules reminder jobs per the reminder rules.
  7. Pushes a notification to the bell of staff & owner.

Returns 409 if the slot is no longer available (race condition).
Pass `skipConflictCheck=true` (owner only) to force-book.
Get a booking.

item.name: Update a booking's mutable fields (notes, etc.).

request.description:
Use the dedicated endpoints for state changes / time changes:
  - `/cancel`, `/reschedule`, `/confirm`, `/complete`, `/no-show`

Only valid for bookings in `pending` status created in the last 5 min.
Confirmed bookings must be cancelled via `/cancel`.

Side effects:
  - Frees the slot for re-booking.
  - If `chargeFee=true`, applies the shop's cancellation fee policy.
  - Triggers the `booking_cancelled` reminder rule.

item.name: Move a booking to a new time / staff member.

request.description:
Re-runs conflict checks at the new slot. Sends `booking_rescheduled`
reminder. Preserves payment intents.
Move a booking from `pending` to `confirmed`.

Side effects:
  - Captures any uncaptured PaymentIntent.
  - Increments client lifetime spend + booking count.
  - Advances loyalty progress.
